+"""Device-side primitives of the mono kernels: wave reductions and shuffles, the
+approximate hardware math, bf16 / fp8 packing, buffer resources, the
+execution-model constants and the kernel symbol naming.
+
+Ported from the FlyDSL GLM-5 layer kernel (ROCm/FlyDSL branch
+``glm5-mla-moe-layer-monokernel`` @ 1e28fd8a,
+``kernels/mla_moe_layer/shared_reuse_moe_kernel.py``). Only published flydsl APIs
+and aiter's vendored ``buffer_ops`` / ``dpp_utils`` are used.
+
+Every function but ``kernel_symbol`` is traced inside a ``@flyc.kernel`` body.
+
+Raw boundaries kept, for want of an equivalent on the pinned FlyDSL:
+``buffer_ops`` loads / stores (the kernels take raw Int64 addresses, no tensors
+for ``make_buffer_tensor``); raw MFMA intrinsics (hand-laid operands: permlane
+transposes, fp8 packing, MXFP4 scales); the LLVM intrinsics here (``expect``,
+``s_memrealtime``, the approximate rsq / rcp / exp2) and the struct unpacking of
+``permlane*_swap``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.dpp_utils import update_dpp_i32
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.kernels_common import format_kernel_name
+from flydsl._mlir import ir
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from flydsl.compiler.ast_rewriter import ASTRewriter
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T, as_ir_value
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.mono.common.plan import THREADS, WAVES
+
+# gfx95x cache policy bits (LLVM CPol): SC0 = 1, SC1 = 16. SC1 alone is device
+# scope (past the per-XCD caches); SC0 | SC1 is system scope (peers over XGMI).
+CM_DEV = 16
+
+
+CM_SYS = 17
+
+
+# NT = 2: nontemporal. A weight a layer reads once streams past the caches it
+# would only evict the step's reused data from (K2b at 48 rows: 143 -> 133 us)
+CM_NT = 2
+
+
+def kernel_signature(**params: object) -> str:
+    """Render build parameters into a kernel-name suffix.
+
+    The #6218 image's FlyDSL does not export aiter's ``kernel_signature``, so
+    this is the same helper: booleans as 0/1, then ``format_kernel_name`` so a
+    hyphen never reaches the assembler.
+    """
+    parts = [
+        f"{name}{int(value) if isinstance(value, bool) else value}"
+        for name, value in params.items()
+    ]
+    return format_kernel_name("_".join(parts))
+
+
+def kernel_symbol(stem, **params):
+    """Kernel symbol that profilers demangle to ``atom::<stem>_<params>``. The
+    amdhsa assembler rejects ``::`` in a symbol, so it is Itanium-mangled, as
+    aiter's ``_ZN5aiter...E`` kernels are."""
+    name = f"{stem}_{kernel_signature(**params)}"
+    return f"_ZN4atom{len(name)}{name}E"
+
+
+def rsrc(addr, nbytes=None):
+    return bo.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(addr, num_records_bytes=nbytes)
+
+
+def permlane_swap(off, x, y):
+    """v_permlane{32,16}_swap on registers (x, y): off 32 trades x's upper-half
+    lanes with y's lower-half lanes; off 16 trades x's odd 16-lane rows with y's
+    even rows (each within its half). -> (x', y')."""
+    swap = rocdl.permlane32_swap if off == 32 else rocdl.permlane16_swap
+    pr = swap(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(x)),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(y)),
+        False,
+        False,
+    )
+    return tuple(fx.Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, pr, [j])) for j in range(2))
+
+
+def lane_gather(v, src_lane):
+    """Lane ``src_lane``'s value of v, a source lane a lane (ds_bpermute)."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        rocdl.ds_bpermute(T.i32, fx.Int32(src_lane) * 4, fx.Int32(v).ir_value())
+    )
+
+
+def readlane(v, src_lane):
+    """Lane ``src_lane``'s value of v (wave-uniform)."""
+    bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+    r = fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, bits, fx.Int32(src_lane)))
+    return r.bitcast(fx.Float32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else r
+
+
+def memrealtime():
+    """s_memrealtime: the 100 MHz device clock (no FlyDSL wrapper)."""
+    return fx.Int64(llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], []))
+
+
+def unlikely(cond):
+    """``cond`` marked cold (llvm.expect): LLVM lays the branch out of the hot
+    path. A rare path's code inline among the hot stages costs them even when it
+    never runs (the long-context selection: S = 16, 3k context +1.4 us)."""
+    return fx.Boolean(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(
+            ir.IntegerType.get_signless(1),
+            "llvm.expect.i1",
+            [as_ir_value(cond), as_ir_value(fx.Boolean(False))],
+            [],
+            [],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def fresh(v):
+    """``v`` (a per-lane Int32) through an opaque move, here: the lane math built
+    on it is computed at its use, where LLVM would otherwise hoist it out of a task
+    loop or CSE it across stages into registers held for the whole kernel (spills,
+    and a kernel with scratch is refused: ``runtime.widths``)."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            T.i32, [fx.Int32(v).ir_value()], "v_mov_b32 $0, $1", "=v,v",
+            has_side_effects=True,
+        )
+    )  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def uniform(v):
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(v).ir_value()))
+
+
+def plus(v, k):
+    """``v + k`` for a Python int ``k``; ``v`` itself, no op, when ``k`` is 0: a
+    task offset that is 0 in a single-pass build traces nothing."""
+    return v if k == 0 else v + k
+
+
+def _hw_f32(name, x):
+    return fx.Float32(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(T.f32, name, [fx.Float32(x).ir_value()], [], [])
+    )
+
+
+def hw_rsq(x):
+    """v_rsq_f32 (~1 ulp, no libm range fixups)."""
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.rsq.f32", x)
+
+
+def hw_rcp(x):
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.rcp.f32", x)
+
+
+def hw_exp2(x):
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.exp2.f32", x)
+
+
+def div_rn(x, d, r):
+    """``x / d`` rounded to nearest, bit-identical to the IEEE division, given
+    ``r = 1.0 / d`` from one true division per divisor (Markstein: a quotient
+    within 1 ulp plus its exact fma residual times RN(1/d) rounds correctly)."""
+    q = x * r
+    return fx.Float32(fmath.fma(fx.Float32(fmath.fma(-q, d, x)), r, q))
+
+
+def xshfl(v, off):
+    """Value of lane ``lane ^ off``: offsets 32 / 16 via v_permlane*_swap, in-row
+    offsets via DPP (VALU latency, not LDS). Powers of two only: any other
+    offset would take the lane ^ 1 path."""
+    assert off in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), off
+    if off >= 16:
+        return v.shuffle_xor(off, 64)
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    if off == 8:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x118, 0xF, 0xC, False))
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(y, x, 0x108, 0xF, 0x3, False))
+    elif off == 4:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x114, 0xF, 0xA, False))
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(y, x, 0x104, 0xF, 0x5, False))
+    elif off == 2:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x4E, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    else:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0xB1, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    return y.bitcast(fx.Float32) if is_f else y
+
+
+def xred(v, off, op):
+    """op(v, lane ^ off) for a symmetric op; 32 / 16 take both halves of one swap."""
+    if off < 16:
+        return op(v, xshfl(v, off))
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    a, b = permlane_swap(off, x, x)
+    if is_f:
+        return op(a.bitcast(fx.Float32), b.bitcast(fx.Float32))
+    return op(type(v)(a), type(v)(b))
+
+
+def _add(a, b):
+    return a + b
+
+
+def butterfly(v, offsets, op=_add):
+    """Butterfly reduction over the given xor offsets, in the given order.
+
+    The order is the numerical contract: the aiter per-head norm reduces 32
+    lanes with offsets 16, 8, 4, 2, 1, and matching it keeps rstd bit-exact."""
+    for off in offsets:
+        v = xred(v, off, op)
+    return v
+
+
+def wave_sum(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+
+
+def traced(fn):
+    """Apply flydsl's AST rewriting to a helper, so its ``while`` / ``if`` over
+    traced values lower to scf ops. Kernels rewrite only their own body."""
+    return ASTRewriter.transform(fn)
+
+
+def wave_max(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), fx.max)
+
+
+@traced
+def block_max(v, lane, wave, red):
+    """Max of v over the CTA's WAVES waves; ``red`` needs WAVES words."""
+    wv = wave_max(v)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if lane == 0:
+        fx.ptr_store(wv, red + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    t = fx.ptr_load(red + 0)
+    for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
+        t = fx.max(t, fx.ptr_load(red + w))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    return t
+
+
+def row_shr(v, lane, k):
+    """DPP row_shr:k of an f32: lane - k of the same 16-lane row, else 0."""
+    moved = lane_gather(v.bitcast(fx.Int32), fx.max(lane - k, 0)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+    return fx.Float32((lane % 16 >= k).select(moved, fx.Float32(0.0)))
+
+
+def _xpartner(v, off, lane):
+    """Lane ``lane ^ off``'s v: DPP within a row, v_permlane*_swap across rows
+    (``xshfl`` takes ``shuffle_xor`` there)."""
+    if off < 16:
+        return xshfl(v, off)
+    a, b = permlane_swap(off, v, v)
+    return ((lane & off) != 0).select(a, b)
+
+
+def wave_incl_scan(v, lane):
+    """Inclusive prefix sum of an Int32 over the wave, in lane order."""
+    blk = v
+    for off in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
+        o = _xpartner(blk, off, lane)
+        v = v + ((lane & off) != 0).select(o, 0)
+        blk = blk + o
+    return v
+
+
+@traced
+def block_excl_scan(v, lane, wave, buf):
+    """(exclusive prefix of v over the CTA in thread order, CTA total); ``buf``
+    needs WAVES words."""
+    incl = wave_incl_scan(v, lane)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if lane == 63:
+        fx.ptr_store(incl, buf + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    off = fx.Int32(0)
+    tot = fx.Int32(0)
+    for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+        cnt = fx.ptr_load(buf + w)
+        off = off + (w < wave).select(cnt, 0)
+        tot = tot + cnt
+    return incl - v + off, tot
+
+
+def global_load(addr, words=1, nt=False):
+    """``words`` i32 (1, 2 or 4) at the 64-bit global address ``addr``. A pool
+    past 4 GiB is reached only this way: a buffer load's offset (index x stride
+    included) is 32 bits. ``nt``: nontemporal."""
+    i32 = ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32)
+    ty = i32 if words == 1 else ir.VectorType.get([words], i32)
+    ptr = llvm.IntToPtrOp(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<1>"), as_ir_value(fx.Int64(addr)))
+    return llvm.LoadOp(
+        ty, ptr.result, alignment=4 * words, nontemporal=nt or None
+    ).result
+
+
+def ld_i32(ptr, i):
+    """Word ``i`` of a buffer, a plain Int32 load."""
+    return fx.Int32(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32))
+
+
+def row_live(batch_ids, k):
+    """Whether row k of the step is a request's: its ``batch_id_per_q_token``
+    entry, -1 on a CUDA-graph pad row (wave-uniform for a uniform k). A pad row
+    runs like any other but joins no decision another row's work depends on."""
+    return uniform(ld_i32(batch_ids, k)) >= 0
+
+
+def ld_dev(ptr, i, words=1):
+    """``words`` i32 (1, 2 or 4) of a buffer from word ``i``, at device scope
+    (past the per-XCD L2)."""
+    return bo.buffer_load(
+        rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=words, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_DEV
+    )
+
+
+LOAD_BATCH = 4  # rounds of a strided loop whose loads go out together
+
+
+@traced
+def batched_rounds(tid, n, load, use, batch=LOAD_BATCH):
+    """A CTA's strided loop over elements v = tid + THREADS i < n (n a Python
+    int): ``load(v)`` of ``batch`` rounds issued before any ``use(v, loaded)``.
+    A round whose ``use`` stores to global memory keeps the next round's loads
+    behind it (they may alias), so the rounds' loads would go out in series. A
+    round past n loads element n - 1 (in range) and uses nothing."""
+    rounds = -(-n // THREADS)
+    for b0 in range_constexpr(0, rounds, batch):
+        idx = range(b0, min(b0 + batch, rounds))
+        got = [load(fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, n - 1)) for i in idx]
+        for i, g in zip(idx, got):
+            v = tid + THREADS * i
+            if v < n:
+                use(v, g)
+
+
+def rows_to_lds(tid, src, rows, row_words, dst, dst_row):
+    """``rows`` rows of ``row_words`` words (a multiple of 4) read at device scope
+    from address ``src`` -> LDS ``dst``, a row every ``dst_row`` words: 16 B a
+    lane, the loads batched (``batched_rounds``)."""
+    assert row_words % 4 == 0, row_words
+    batched_rounds(
+        tid, rows * row_words // 4,
+        lambda v: fx.Vector(ld_dev(src, v * 4, 4)),
+        lambda v, w: fx.ptr_store(
+            w, dst + (v * 4 // row_words * dst_row + v * 4 % row_words)
+        ),
+    )  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def mfma_bf16(a, b, c):
+    return fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.vec(4, T.f32), [a, b, c]))
+
+
+def row_sum(red, r, t, waves=None):
+    """Row r, token t of the waves' 16x16 MFMA accumulators (wave w's at ``red``
+    + (w * 64 + lane) * 4), summed in wave order from 0 (``waves``: which, in
+    order; all of them by default)."""
+    tot = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for w in waves if waves is not None else range(WAVES):
+        tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red + ((w * 64 + 16 * (r // 4) + t) * 4 + r % 4))
+    return tot
+
+
+def mfma_fp8(a, b, c):
+    """16x16x32 fp8 x fp8 MFMA, unscaled: ``a`` / ``b`` an i64 of 8 E4M3 each."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_fp8_fp8(T.vec(4, T.f32), [a, b, c, 0, 0, 0])
+    )
+
+
+def ballot(pred):
+    """The wave's lanes where ``pred`` holds, a bit a lane."""
+    return fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, as_ir_value(pred)))
+
+
+def popcount(x):
+    return fx.Int32(fx.ctpop(x))
+
+
+def lanes_below(bal, lane):
+    """How many of the lanes in ballot ``bal`` are below ``lane``."""
+    return popcount(bal & ((fx.Int64(1) << fx.Int64(lane)) - 1))
+
+
+def load_ptr64(table, i):
+    """Entry ``i`` of an i64 table in memory, wave-uniform (each half through
+    ``uniform``): a peer's buffer base, a kernel argument block's pointer."""
+    pw = fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(table), i * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32))
+    return (fx.Int64(uniform(pw[1])) << 32) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(uniform(pw[0])))
+
+
+def fp8x8_bf16_pk(words):
+    """Eight fp8 of two dwords -> bf16 MFMA operand (exact) by
+    v_cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp8 (scale 1), two values an instruction."""
+    out = []
+    for w in words:
+        for hi in (False, True):
+            p = rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp8(
+                T.bf16x2, as_ir_value(fx.Int32(w)), as_ir_value(fx.Float32(1.0)), hi
+            )
+            out.append(fx.Vector(p).bitcast(fx.Int32)[0])
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements(out, fx.Int32).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+
+
+def bf16_round(a):
+    return fx.Float32(fx.Float32(a).to(fx.BFloat16))
+
+
+def bf16_pair(a, b):
+    """Two f32 -> one f32-typed word holding (bf16(a), bf16(b))."""
+    return (
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([a, b], fx.Float32)
+        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+        .bitcast(fx.Float32)[0]
+    )
+
+
+def lds_bytes(struct) -> int:
+    """The LDS an ``fx.struct`` class takes, alignment included."""
+    return struct.__dsl_size_of__()
+
+
+def bf_lo(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's low half."""
+    return (w << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf_hi(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's high half."""
+    return (w & fx.Int32(-65536)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf2_f32(w):
+    """Packed bf16 pair word -> (f32 low, f32 high)."""
+    return bf_lo(w), bf_hi(w)
+
+
+def fp8_pack4(a, b, c, d):
+    """Four f32 (already in range) -> one dword of four E4M3 bytes, RNE."""
+    lo = fx.Int32(rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, a, b, fx.Int32(0), False))
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, c, d, lo, True))

+FlyDSL keys a compiled kernel by the scalar values (int, float, bool, str, enum,
+tuple) its launcher's closures capture; an object in a closure is not keyed, and
+a parameter used only by build-time Python (a placement table, a layout) is in no
+closure at all. Two builds differing only there would share one binary -- every
+TP rank ran rank 3's kernel once that way. So a build's parameters are one frozen
+dataclass of scalars, ``key_tuple`` turns it into one (name, value) tuple, and the
+launcher references that tuple: every field is keyed, whatever the body uses.
+
+The tuple also carries the model's kernel sources (``source_digest``): FlyDSL
+keys a helper's source only when its walk reaches it, and it does not reach a
+helper called inside a traced function's dynamic loop or branch (the rewriter
+moves those bodies into nested functions it does not scan) nor one outside the
+kernel's directory -- an edit there kept the old binary.
+"""
+
+import enum
+import functools
+import hashlib
+import inspect
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field, fields
+from enum import Enum
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.mono.tiling import DEFAULT_GRID
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.mono.tiling import THREADS as THREADS
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.mono.tiling import WAVES as WAVES
+
+_SCALARS = (int, float, bool, str, enum.Enum)
+_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def source_digest(*paths: str) -> str:
+    """sha256 of every ``.py`` file under ``paths`` (files or directories,
+    relative to the ``mono`` package), each file's path and contents: one model's
+    kernel sources, so an edit to another model's rebuilds none of these."""
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    for rel in paths:
+        root = _ROOT / rel
+        files = [root] if root.is_file() else sorted(root.rglob("*.py"))
+        if not files:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"no kernel sources at {root}")
+        for f in files:
+            h.update(str(f.relative_to(_ROOT)).encode())
+            h.update(f.read_bytes())
+    return h.hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def key_tuple(key, sources: str) -> tuple:
+    """``key``'s (field name, value) pairs, every value a scalar, then
+    ("sources", ``sources``): the model's ``source_digest``."""
+    out = []
+    for f in fields(key):
+        value = getattr(key, f.name)
+        if not isinstance(value, _SCALARS):
+            raise TypeError(
+                f"{type(key).__name__}.{f.name} = {value!r}: a build parameter must be"
+                " a scalar to reach the JIT cache key"
+            )
+        out.append((f.name, value))
+    out.append(("sources", sources))
+    return tuple(out)
+
+
+def symbol_params(key) -> dict:
+    """The fields that name the kernel symbol (``metadata={"sym": short name}``),
+    short name -> value, in field order."""
+    return {
+        f.metadata["sym"]: getattr(key, f.name)
+        for f in fields(key)
+        if "sym" in f.metadata
+    }
+
+
+# The execution model every mono kernel is written for.
+#
+# One CTA per CU, all of them co-resident -- a spin wait on another CTA can only
+# make progress if that CTA is running, so the runner refuses a GPU whose CU
+# count has no validated grid -- and THREADS threads each. The grid width is a
+# build parameter (``tiling.resolve_grid``): 256 on MI355X / MI350X, 128 on
+# MI350P. BLOCKS is the MI355X width.
+#
+
+BLOCKS = DEFAULT_GRID
+LDS_BYTES = 160 * 1024  # a CU's LDS: one CTA's whole
+
+
+def first_task(bid, base, blocks=BLOCKS):
+    """CTA ``bid``'s first task of a stage placed from CTA ``base`` (any count of
+    CTAs past 0: placements that add task counts run past the grid), then every
+    ``blocks``-th."""
+    return (bid - base % blocks + blocks) % blocks
+
+
+# A kernel's mailbox regions laid out in its scratch or peer buffer.
+
+PAIR_BYTES = 8  # a (value, tag) pair
+# a debug build's wait record, one a CTA: flag, region id, pair index, tag,
+# seen tag, CTA, clock, pad (``vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.mono.common.sync._spin_bounded``)
+DIAG_WORDS = 8
+
+
+def pair_layout(items, align: int = PAIR_BYTES, start: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """``items`` (name, pairs) laid out in order: name -> (byte offset, bytes),
+    each region from an ``align``-byte boundary at or past ``start``."""
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, pairs in items:
+        off = (off + align - 1) // align * align
+        out[name] = (off, pairs * PAIR_BYTES)
+        off += pairs * PAIR_BYTES
+    return out
+
+
+# A kernel's argument list, named once.
+#
+# A FlyDSL kernel and its launcher each spell out their positional parameters, and
+# the host passes them by position: an argument out of order is a pointer read as
+# another, silently. ``KernelAbi`` is the one list of names; the build checks the
+# kernel's and the launcher's parameters against it, and the host packs by name.
+#
+
+
+def _python_params(fn) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Parameter names of a ``@flyc.kernel`` / ``@flyc.jit`` object's Python
+    function (FlyDSL keeps it as ``_func`` / ``func``)."""
+    py = getattr(fn, "func", None) or getattr(fn, "_func", None)
+    if py is None:
+        raise TypeError(f"no Python function behind {fn!r}")
+    return tuple(inspect.signature(py).parameters)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class KernelAbi:
+    names: tuple[str, ...]
+
+    def check(self, kernel, launcher) -> None:
+        """The kernel takes exactly ``names``; the launcher too, then ``stream``."""
+        got = _python_params(kernel)
+        if got != self.names:
+            raise TypeError(f"kernel parameters {got} != ABI {self.names}")
+        got = _python_params(launcher)
+        if got != (*self.names, "stream"):
+            raise TypeError(f"launcher parameters {got} != ABI {self.names} + stream")
+
+    def pack(self, values: dict) -> list:
+        """``values`` (every name, nothing else) in ABI order."""
+        try:
+            if len(values) == len(self.names):
+                return [values[n] for n in self.names]
+        except KeyError:
+            pass
+        extra = sorted(set(values) - set(self.names))
+        missing = sorted(set(self.names) - set(values))
+        raise TypeError(f"ABI mismatch: missing {missing}, unexpected {extra}")
+
+    def zeros(self) -> list:
+        """Every argument 0: what a compile-only call passes."""
+        return [0] * len(self.names)
+
+
+# A kernel's mailbox accesses, recorded while FlyDSL traces it.
+#
+# Tracing runs the kernel body's Python once, so every mailbox put / poll executes
+# once as Python: noting it here costs the device nothing (no IR is emitted). The
+# stage currently being traced is set by ``enter_stage``, called where the program
+# starts each stage, so the record is ``(stage, region, put | poll)`` in program
+# order.
+#
+# Everything here is plain functions on a module-level recorder: FlyDSL's AST
+# rewriter carries every local whose method is called inside a dynamic if / for as
+# loop state, so a kernel body must not call methods on these objects.
+#
+
+
+class Space(Enum):
+    SCRATCH = "scratch"  # this GPU's memory: device-scope hand-off between CTAs
+    PEER = "peer"  # a peer-symmetric region: system-scope hand-off between GPUs
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Access:
+    stage: str
+    region: str
+    space: Space
+    kind: str  # "put" | "poll"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Record:
+    stages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # in the order entered
+    accesses: list[Access] = field(default_factory=list)
+    unnamed: list[tuple[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)  # (stage, kind)
+
+
+_record: Record | None = None
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def recording():
+    """Record the accesses of kernels traced inside this block."""
+    global _record
+    outer, _record = _record, Record()
+    try:
+        yield _record
+    finally:
+        _record = outer
+
+
+def enter_stage(name: str) -> None:
+    if _record is not None:
+        _record.stages.append(name)
+
+
+def _stage() -> str:
+    assert _record is not None
+    return _record.stages[-1] if _record.stages else "<before any stage>"
+
+
+def note(region: str, space: Space, kind: str) -> None:
+    if _record is not None:
+        _record.accesses.append(Access(_stage(), region, space, kind))
+
+
+def note_unnamed(kind: str) -> None:
+    """A put / poll on a raw address: the check reports it (every mailbox access of
+    a checked kernel names its region)."""
+    if _record is not None:
+        _record.unnamed.append((_stage(), kind))

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project

+# atom/mono/device/sync.py
+"""The tagged mailbox: hand-offs between the CTAs of one GPU (device scope) and
+between GPUs (system scope), every address a named region (``Addr``) recorded
+when the kernel is traced (``trace``)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    CM_SYS,
+    bf16_pair,
+    memrealtime,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.mono.common.plan import DIAG_WORDS, Space, note
+
+POLL_MAX = 12  # mailbox specs polled per batch (bounds live registers)
+
+
+@traced
+def _spin(load_all, pending):
+    """Re-issue ``load_all`` until ``pending`` clears; a side-effecting op in the
+    loop keeps the loads from being hoisted."""
+    v = load_all()
+    while pending(v):
+        rocdl.s_sleep(1)
+        v = load_all()
+    return v
+
+
+# a debug build's mailbox wait gives up after this long (100 MHz ticks: 10 s)
+DIAG_TICKS = 10 * 100_000_000
+
+
+@traced
+def _spin_bounded(load_all, pending, diag, region_id, index, tag):
+    """``_spin`` giving up after DIAG_TICKS: the CTA's record in ``diag`` names the
+    wait (the runner raises with it after the step), and the kernel runs on."""
+    t0 = memrealtime()
+    v = load_all()
+    late = fx.Int32(0)
+    while pending(v) & (late == 0):
+        rocdl.s_sleep(1)
+        v = load_all()
+        late = (memrealtime() - t0 > DIAG_TICKS).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+    if late != 0:
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        # the CTA's first give-up of the step: the later ones wait on its fallout
+        seen = bo.buffer_load(
+            rsrc(diag),
+            bid * DIAG_WORDS,
+            vec_width=1,
+            dtype=T.i32,
+            cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+        )
+        if fx.Int32(seen) == 0:
+            at = fx.Int32(memrealtime() & 0x7FFFFFFF)
+            record = [1, region_id, index, tag, v[1], bid, at, 0]
+            for h in range_constexpr(2):  # 16 B a store
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                        [fx.Int32(w) for w in record[4 * h : 4 * h + 4]], fx.Int32
+                    ),
+                    rsrc(diag),
+                    bid * DIAG_WORDS + 4 * h,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+    return v
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Addr:
+    """A mailbox region's address: the region's name and space, recorded when the
+    kernel is traced (``trace``), and the traced address. The space also
+    sets the hand-off's scope: device for SCRATCH, system for PEER."""
+
+    region: str
+    space: Space
+    value: object
+
+
+def sreg(base, offset, region):
+    """Scratch region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.SCRATCH, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def preg(base, offset, region):
+    """Peer-symmetric region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of a rank's buffer
+    ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.PEER, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def shift(a, delta):
+    """``a`` moved by ``delta`` bytes (a traced or Python integer), same region."""
+    return Addr(a.region, a.space, a.value + delta)
+
+
+# the store / load cache policy of a hand-off in each space
+_SCOPE_CM = {Space.SCRATCH: CM_DEV, Space.PEER: CM_SYS}
+
+
+def _noted(a, kind):
+    note(a.region, a.space, kind)
+    return a.value
+
+
+class Mailbox:
+    """Tagged-pair hand-off between CTAs (device scope) and GPUs (system scope).
+
+    Every 32-bit value is stored next to this launch's tag; a consumer
+    polls the payload until all tags match, so a hand-off costs one round trip
+    (no store drain, no separate flag). The tag is ``layer + 1``: it tells the
+    layers of one step apart, and the runner zeroes every mailbox at a step's
+    start (``StepMailboxes.begin_step``), so a pair from an earlier step never
+    carries a live tag. Every address is an ``Addr``: its space picks the scope.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, layer, diag=None, region_ids=None):
+        """``diag`` (a debug build): the address of the per-CTA wait records, every
+        wait bounded (``_spin_bounded``); ``region_ids``: region name -> the id a
+        record names it by."""
+        self.tag = layer + 1
+        self.diag = diag
+        self.region_ids = region_ids or {}
+
+    def put(self, a, i, v):
+        bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([bits, self.tag], fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(_noted(a, "put")),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_bf(self, a, i, vs):
+        """Elements i .. i+len(vs) (2 or 4, i aligned) as packed bf16 pairs, one
+        store."""
+        words = []
+        for j in range_constexpr(len(vs) // 2):
+            words += [bf16_pair(vs[2 * j], vs[2 * j + 1]).bitcast(fx.Int32), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(_noted(a, "put")),
+            i,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_words(self, a, i, words):
+        """Raw 32-bit words (1 or 2) at pairs i.. as (word, tag). Integer payloads
+        (fp8 words) must come this way: through an f32 value a NaN bit pattern is
+        not kept."""
+        vals = []
+        for w in words:
+            vals += [fx.Int32(w), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(vals, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(_noted(a, "put")),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def poll(self, specs, batch=POLL_MAX):
+        """Batched poll of pairs ``specs`` = [(Addr, pair index, npairs in {1, 2})],
+        all of one space.
+
+        All pairs are re-loaded together while any tag is stale, so a batch costs
+        one round trip after its last producer lands. Returns the value words."""
+        if const_expr(len(specs) == 0):
+            return []
+        if const_expr(len(specs) > batch):
+            return self.poll(specs[:batch], batch) + self.poll(specs[batch:], batch)
+        spaces = {a.space for a, _, _ in specs}
+        assert len(spaces) == 1, f"one poll batch spans {spaces}"
+        cm = _SCOPE_CM[spaces.pop()]
+        bases = [_noted(a, "poll") for a, _, _ in specs]
+        tag = self.tag
+
+        def load_all():
+            words = []
+            for b, (_, i, n) in zip(bases, specs):
+                w = fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        rsrc(b),
+                        fx.Int32(i) * 2,
+                        vec_width=2 * n,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=cm,
+                    )
+                )
+                words += [w[e] for e in range(2 * n)]
+            return fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32)
+
+        nw = sum(2 * n for _, _, n in specs)
+
+        def pending(v):
+            bad = v[1] != tag
+            for e in range_constexpr(3, nw, 2):
+                bad = bad | (v[e] != tag)
+            return bad
+
+        if const_expr(self.diag is None):
+            v = _spin(load_all, pending)
+        else:
+            rid = self.region_ids.get(specs[0][0].region, -1)
+            v = _spin_bounded(load_all, pending, self.diag, rid, specs[0][1], tag)
+        outs, e = [], 0
+        for _, _, n in specs:
+            outs.append([v[e + 2 * q] for q in range(n)])
+            e += 2 * n
+        return outs
+
+
+@traced
+def publish(put, a, i, v, who):
+    """This CTA's plain stores made readable by every CTA, then (thread ``who``)
+    the mailbox pair (``a``, i) := v. The stores are drained first: a flag may
+    not overtake the data it announces, and a workgroup-scope release fence does
+    not wait for them (LLVM's AMDGPU memory model omits vmcnt outside tgsplit
+    mode: the workgroup's waves share one CU, the readers here do not)."""
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if who:
+        put(a, i, v)

+"""``dense_ffn``: the FFN half of a dense Qwen3.8-27B decoder layer as one
+persistent launch, ``grid`` x ``THREADS``, S <= 8 decode rows (TP1 below):
+
+    norm     (every CTA, redundantly; the first gate_up weights already in
+             flight): h + residual (fp32) -> ``res_out`` (bf16, spread over the
+             CTAs); post_attention_layernorm (Gemma, 1 + w) -> bf16 x -> MXFP4
+             qdq (1 x 32 blocks, Quark "even" scales, as aiter's Triton
+             ``dynamic_mxfp4_quant``) -> LDS
+    gate_up  (1088 groups of 16 intermediate columns: CTA b groups 4 b .. 4 b + 3
+             whole, then 4 columns of group 1024 + b / 4; wave w: gate / up by
+             w % 2, K quarter w / 2): MXFP4 weights against the x rows in the
+             stock GEMM's K chains (below) -> bf16 g, u -> bf16(bf16(silu(g)) u);
+             each pair of whole groups (a 32-column block) through MXFP4 qdq ->
+             HQ, the 4 columns bf16 -> H; one ready flag a CTA
+    down     (CTA b: hidden row group b whole, then 4 rows of group 256 + b / 4;
+             wave w: the group by w % 2, K quarter w / 2): HQ, and H's other
+             columns through MXFP4 qdq, -> LDS; the weights against them in the
+             stock GEMM's K chains -> bf16 ``out``
+
+At TP2 (``FfnBuild.tp``, ``normed``) a rank runs its half of the intermediate
+(``FGeo``) from the stock post_attention_layernorm's output, qdq'd per CTA, and
+writes down's partial before the all-reduce: 544 groups, 2 whole a CTA and 2
+columns of the 32 others.
+
+The CTA counts above are the 256-CTA grid (``FfnBuild.grid``, MI355X). On 128
+CTAs (MI350P, ``tiling``) a CTA takes 8 whole gate_up groups and 8 columns of
+a split one [TP2: 4 and 4], down's whole row groups b and 128 + b and 8 rows of
+split group 256 + b / 2 in two passes (the two whole tiles, then the split one
+on the even waves), and o_proj's owners 128 + b (b < 32) in a second pass. Each
+task's arithmetic is the same at either width.
+
+Every GEMM is bit-exact with the stock ``gemm_afp4wfp4`` by construction: each
+output takes the stock kernel's K splits (``gu_splits``, ``d_splits``,
+``O_SPLITS``), each a chain of scaled MFMAs over the 128-K steps in K order from
+a zero accumulator (a wave's quarter continues the previous quarter's
+accumulator), then the split partials added as the stock split-K reduce
+(``split_total``) and one bf16 rounding. The MFMA shape (16x16x128 here,
+32x32x64 in stock up to 8 rows) does not change the bits; any other K grouping
+does, on rows whose exact sums span more than 24 bits.
+
+Weights are the checkpoint's as SGLang keeps them for ``gemm_afp4wfp4``: fp4x2
+[N, K / 2] row-major (low nibble the even column), e8m0 scales [N, K / 32].
+A load past a weight's end (a dead slot) reads zeros at no memory traffic.

+
+# The stock GEMMs' K splits on this image. These shapes have no tuned
+# gemm_afp4wfp4 config, so M<=8 uses DEFAULT.json (NUM_KSPLIT 4, BLOCK_K 512)
+# after get_splitk, and wider steps use NUM_KSPLIT 1. o_proj (K 6144) stays 4.
+# Other AITER versions split differently (``get_splitk`` of AITER main at
+# 59fae207 gives gate_up 2, down 2 at TP1 and 1 at TP2): a build takes the
+# installed AITER's counts through ``FfnBuild.gu_split`` / ``d_split`` /
+# ``o_split`` (``stock_split_fields``), these defaults where they agree.
+O_SPLITS = 4
+SPLIT_COUNTS = (1, 2, 4)  # K splits a tile's chain takes: whole, halves, quarters
+
+
+def gu_splits(s: int) -> int:
+    """Stock gate_up K splits (K 5120): 4 up to 8 rows, 1 above."""
+    return 4 if s <= MAX_TOKENS else 1
+
+
+def d_splits(s: int, tp: int) -> int:
+    """Stock down K splits up to 8 rows: 4 at TP1 (K 17408), 2 at TP2 (K 8704).
+    Wider steps are 1 split."""
+    if s > MAX_TOKENS:
+        return 1
+    return 4 if tp == 1 else 2
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def stock_splits(m: int, n: int, k: int) -> int:
+    """K splits of the stock MXFP4 GEMM (AITER Triton ``gemm_afp4wfp4``) at M
+    ``m`` for an [n, k] weight: the partials it returns with ``skip_reduce``.
+    Runs one small GEMM on the GPU, once per shape."""
+    from aiter.ops.triton.gemm_afp4wfp4 import gemm_afp4wfp4
+    from aiter.ops.triton.quant import dynamic_mxfp4_quant
+
+    xq, xs = dynamic_mxfp4_quant(torch.zeros(m, k, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda"))
+    w = torch.zeros(n, k // 2, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    ws = torch.full((n, k // 32), 127, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    p = gemm_afp4wfp4(xq, w, xs, ws, torch.bfloat16, skip_reduce=True)
+    return p.size(0) if p.dim() == 3 else 1
+
+
+def stock_split_fields(s: int, tp: int, oproj: bool) -> dict:
+    """``FfnBuild`` fields for the installed AITER's K splits at S rows: each 0
+    where it equals this module's default (so the build is #61573's), else the
+    count. ValueError for a count K2 cannot take."""
+    inter = FGeo(tp).inter
+    got = {
+        "gu_split": (stock_splits(s, 2 * inter, HIDDEN), gu_splits(s)),
+        "d_split": (stock_splits(s, HIDDEN, inter), d_splits(s, tp)),
+    }
+    if oproj:
+        got["o_split"] = (stock_splits(s, HIDDEN, CORE), O_SPLITS)
+    for name, (n, _) in got.items():
+        if n not in SPLIT_COUNTS:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"the stock MXFP4 GEMM splits {name[:-6]}'s K in {n} at {s} rows; "
+                f"K2 reproduces {SPLIT_COUNTS} splits only"
+            )
+    return {name: 0 if n == default else n for name, (n, default) in got.items()}
+
+
+def split_total(vals):
+    """fp32 split partials added as the stock split-K reduce: ``tl.sum`` over
+    the split axis padded with zeros to a power of 2 (adjacent pairs, then
+    pairs of pairs); one split is the chain itself."""
+    v = list(vals)
+    while len(v) & (len(v) - 1):
+        v.append(fx.Float32(0.0))
+    while len(v) > 1:
+        v = [v[2 * i] + v[2 * i + 1] for i in range(len(v) // 2)]
+    return v[0]
+
+
+# FGeo (``tiling``): a TP rank's share of the FFN on the build's grid. TP1: 1088
+# groups, down's K 136 steps; TP2: 544, 68 steps.
+
+# o_proj (FfnBuild.oproj): owner task o < O_CTAS has hidden columns 32 o .. 32 o
+# + 31; CTA b runs owners b, b + grid, ... (one pass on 256 CTAs, two on 128)
+O_CTAS = O_TASKS  # 160
+OQROW = CORE // 8 + 4
+OSROW = CORE // 32
+X_PAIRS = 5  # a (token, owner) x hand-off: 4 fp4 words, the code
+
+# norm
+CHUNKS = HIDDEN // 8  # 640 chunks of 8 columns a row
+CH_WAVES = CHUNKS // 64  # 10 wave-sized runs of chunks a row
+# The stock Triton Gemma norm (minimax_m3_rmsnorm, 8192-wide block): 16 warps,
+# a thread 8 columns; DPP row_shr 8..1, row_bcast 15 / 31 in a warp.
+NORM_WARPS = 16
+WAVE_ORDER = (8, 4, 2, 1, 16, 32)
+MAX_ROUNDS = (MAX_TOKENS * CHUNKS + THREADS - 1) // THREADS  # 10
+
+# the grid-dependent invariants (whole-group pairs, column / row pairs) are
+# checked for every validated grid by ``tiling.check_ffn``
+assert CHUNKS % 64 == 0
+
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+STAMPS = 8  # debug stamps a CTA
+
+
+def stamp(c, k):
+    """Thread 0: the 100 MHz clock -> stamp k of this CTA (debug builds)."""
+    if c["stamps"] is not None:
+        _stamp(c, k)
+
+
+@traced
+def _stamp(c, k):
+    t = memrealtime()
+    if c["tid"] == 0:
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                [fx.Int32(t & 0xFFFFFFFF), fx.Int32(t >> 32)], fx.Int32
+            ),
+            rsrc(c["stamps"]),
+            (c["bid"] * STAMPS + k) * 2,
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FfnBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    eps: float = 1e-6
+    # debug: phases < stop only (1 norm, 2 gate_up, 3 down)
+    stop: int = 99
+    # debug: per-CTA s_memrealtime stamps at the phase ends -> scratch "stamps"
+    stamps: bool = False
+    # weights in aiter's shuffle_weight(layout=(16, 16)) order: a 16-row
+    # group's 16 B K chunks as [chunk][row % 16][16 B] (``shuffle_w``)
+    shuffled: bool = False
+    # o_proj / out_proj folded in: ``hidden`` is its input (the attention's
+    # core, bf16 [S, CORE]); MXFP4 qdq + the GEMV by the owner CTAs, then the
+    # norm distributed (sum-of-squares and fp4 x hand-offs). Needs ``shuffled``.
+    oproj: bool = False
+    # the rank's share at TP ``tp`` (``FGeo``)
+    tp: int = 1
+    # ``hidden`` is post_attention_layernorm's bf16 output: no residual, no
+    # res_out; ``out`` gets down's output (at TP2 the rank's partial)
+    normed: bool = False
+    # CTAs, one a CU, all resident (``tiling.resolve_grid``): 256 MI355X, 128
+    # MI350P
+    grid: int = DEFAULT_GRID
+    # the stock GEMMs' K splits of gate_up, down and o_proj (1, 2 or 4); 0: the
+    # defaults ``gu_splits`` / ``d_splits`` / ``O_SPLITS`` (``stock_split_fields``)
+    gu_split: int = 0
+    d_split: int = 0
+    o_split: int = 0
+
+
+def key_splits(key: "FfnBuild") -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """(gate_up, down, o_proj) K splits of a build."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    return (
+        key.gu_split or gu_splits(s),
+        key.d_split or d_splits(s, key.tp),
+        key.o_split or O_SPLITS,
+    )
+
+
+ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "hidden",
+        "residual",
+        "w_o",
+        "w_os",
+        "ln_w",
+        "w13",
+        "w13s",
+        "w2",
+        "w2s",
+        "out",
+        "res_out",
+        "scratch",
+        "epoch",
+        "layer",
+    )
+)
+
+
+def scratch_layout(key: FfnBuild) -> dict:
+    s = key.tokens
+    geo = FGeo(key.tp, key.grid)
+    lay = pair_layout(
+        (
+            ("hrdy", key.grid),
+            ("nsum", CHUNKS * s),
+            ("xmb", s * O_CTAS * X_PAIRS),
+        )
+    )
+    end = max(o + n for o, n in lay.values())
+    # H: bf16 [S, inter] (the split groups' columns); HQ: its whole groups'
+    # blocks as fp4 words [S, blocks, 4] and e8m0 codes [S, blocks], an i32 each
+    lay["h"] = ((end + 255) // 256 * 256, s * geo.inter * 2)
+    lay["hq"] = (lay["h"][0] + lay["h"][1], s * geo.inter // 2)
+    lay["hqs"] = (lay["hq"][0] + lay["hq"][1], s * geo.blocks * 4)
+    lay["stamps"] = (lay["hqs"][0] + lay["hqs"][1], key.grid * STAMPS * 8)
+    return lay
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(key: FfnBuild) -> int:
+    return max(o + n for o, n in scratch_layout(key).values())
+
+
+def mx_code_even(amax):
+    """A 1 x 32 block's e8m0 code from its abs max, Quark "even" (aiter's Triton
+    ``_mxfp4_scale_from_amax``): the exponent of amax rounded up past 1.75,
+    minus 2, clamped to 0 .. 254."""
+    bits = amax.bitcast(fx.Int32)
+    e = ((bits + fx.Int32(0x200000)) >> 23) & 0xFF
+    return fx.min(fx.max(e - 2, fx.Int32(0)), fx.Int32(254))
+
+
+def pack8(vs, code):
+    """8 fp32 -> e2m1 at e8m0 ``code`` (v_cvt_scalef32_pk_fp4_f32: nearest even,
+    saturating, bit-exact with aiter's Triton quant) -> an i32, element 2 j / 2 j
+    + 1 the low / high nibble of byte j. ``code`` >= 1 (``mx_code``)."""
+    sc = pow2(code)
+    w = fx.Int32(0)
+    for j in range(4):
+        w = fx.Int32(
+            rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp4_f32(
+                T.i32, w, fx.Float32(vs[2 * j]), fx.Float32(vs[2 * j + 1]), sc, j
+            )
+        )
+    return w
+
+
+def mx_code(amax):
+    """``mx_code_even`` with code 0 (an all-zero block: its fp4 are 0 at any
+    scale) taken as 1, a scale the conversion can divide by."""
+    return fx.max(mx_code_even(amax), fx.Int32(1))
+
+
+def ld4(r, at, cm=0):
+    return fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(r, at, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=cm))
+
+
+def pack_bf(vs):
+    """f32 list (even length) -> i32 list of packed bf16 pairs."""
+    return [
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([vs[2 * j], vs[2 * j + 1]], fx.Float32)
+        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+        .bitcast(fx.Int32)[0]
+        for j in range(len(vs) // 2)
+    ]
+
+
+def tl_sqrt(x):
+    """Triton's ``tl.sqrt``: the raw v_sqrt_f32."""
+    return fx.Float32(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(
+            T.f32, "llvm.amdgcn.sqrt.f32", [fx.Float32(x).ir_value()], [], []
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def chunk_ss(z):
+    """A chunk's sum of squares as the stock norm's ISA forms it: packed pairs,
+    its mul / add tree fp-contracted."""
+    sq = lambda e: fx.Float32(fmath.fma(z[e], z[e], z[e + 2] * z[e + 2]))  # noqa: E731
+    return (sq(0) + sq(4)) + (sq(1) + sq(5))
+
+
+def _add_live(x, y):
+    """X + y, None standing for a zero partial."""
+    return x if y is None else y if x is None else x + y
+
+
+def runs_total(runs):
+    """A row's CH_WAVES run sums combined as the stock norm's NORM_WARPS warp
+    partials (xor 8, 4, 2, 1; warps past the row hold zeros)."""
+    v = list(runs) + [None] * (NORM_WARPS - len(runs))
+    for off in (8, 4, 2, 1):
+        v = [_add_live(v[i], v[i + off]) for i in range(off)]
+    return v[0]
+
+
+def stock_rstd(tot, eps):
+    """The stock norm's 1 / sqrt(sum / n + eps): IEEE divisions, raw sqrt."""
+    return fx.Float32(1.0) / tl_sqrt(tot / fx.Float32(HIDDEN) + fx.Float32(eps))
+
+
+def silu_mul_bf(g, u):
+    """SiluAndMul on ROCm: silu(g) rounded to bf16 before the multiply."""
+    return bf16_round(g * sigmoid(g)) * u
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- norm
+def norm_loads(c, first=False):
+    """Chunk ``tid + 512 i`` of the S rows (8 columns; every round's live chunks
+    of a wave in one row): raw h / residual words and the 1 + w words. ``first``:
+    no residual (the model's first layer)."""
+    s, tid, a = c["S"], c["tid"], c["args"]
+    n = s * CHUNKS
+    out = []
+    for i in range((n + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        ch = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, n - 1)
+        hw = ld4(rsrc(a["hidden"]), ch * 4)
+        rw = None if first else ld4(rsrc(a["residual"]), ch * 4)
+        out.append((hw, rw, ld4(rsrc(a["ln_w"]), ch % CHUNKS * 4)))
+    return out
+
+
+@traced
+def run_norm(c, raw, marks=True):
+    """Z = h + residual (h alone without a residual) -> res_out (chunk run
+    ch / 16 by CTA run % grid); every row's sum of squares (a wave's 64 chunks a
+    run, as the stock norm) -> rstd -> bf16 x -> qdq by 32 columns (four lanes
+    a block) -> the LDS x rows. ``marks``: debug stamps 5 and 6."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave, bid = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["bid"]
+    nrm, rst = c["nrm"], c["rst"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    grid = c["G"].grid
+    n = s * CHUNKS
+    zs = []
+    for i in range_constexpr(len(raw)):
+        hw, rw, _ = raw[i]
+        z = []
+        for d in range_constexpr(4):
+            if const_expr(rw is None):
+                z += [bf_lo(hw[d]), bf_hi(hw[d])]
+            else:
+                z += [bf_lo(hw[d]) + bf_lo(rw[d]), bf_hi(hw[d]) + bf_hi(rw[d])]
+        zs.append(z)
+        ss = butterfly(chunk_ss(z), WAVE_ORDER)
+        if lane == 0:
+            fx.ptr_store(ss, nrm + (i * WAVES + wave))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if const_expr(marks):
+        stamp(c, 5)
+    if tid < s:
+        tot = runs_total(
+            [fx.ptr_load(nrm + (tid * CH_WAVES + k)) for k in range(CH_WAVES)]
+        )
+        fx.ptr_store(stock_rstd(tot, c["eps"]), rst + tid)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if const_expr(marks):
+        stamp(c, 6)
+    for i in range_constexpr(len(raw)):
+        ch_raw = tid + THREADS * i
+        live = ch_raw < n
+        ch = fx.min(ch_raw, n - 1)
+        t = ch // CHUNKS
+        col = ch % CHUNKS * 8
+        z = zs[i]
+        wv = raw[i][2]
+        lnw = []
+        for d in range_constexpr(4):
+            lnw += [fx.Float32(1.0) + bf_lo(wv[d]), fx.Float32(1.0) + bf_hi(wv[d])]
+        if live & ((ch // 16) % grid == bid):
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(pack_bf(z), fx.Int32),
+                rsrc(a["res_out"]),
+                ch * 4,
+            )
+        r = fx.ptr_load(rst + t)
+        x = [bf16_round(z[e] * r * lnw[e]) for e in range(8)]
+        amax = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for e in range_constexpr(8):
+            amax = fx.max(amax, fx.Float32(fmath.absf(x[e])))
+        amax = xred(xred(amax, 1, fx.max), 2, fx.max)
+        code = mx_code(amax)
+        w = pack8(x, code)
+        if live:
+            fx.ptr_store(w, c["xq"] + (t * XQROW + col // 8))
+            if ch % 4 == 0:
+                fx.ptr_store(code, c["xs"] + (t * XSROW + col // 32))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- o_proj
+def owner(c, own=None):
+    """Owner task ``own``, the CTA's first (``bid``) by default."""
+    return c["bid"] if own is None else own
+
+
+def o_owner(c, own=None):
+    """Owner task ``own`` (the CTA's first by default), clamped to a real one."""
+    return fx.min(owner(c, own), O_CTAS - 1)
+
+
+def o_more(c):
+    """The CTA's owner tasks past its first: ``bid + p grid`` for passes p >= 1
+    (none on 256 CTAs; 128 + b on CTAs b < 32 of 128)."""
+    return [c["bid"] + p * c["G"].grid for p in range(1, c["G"].o_passes)]
+
+
+def block_loads(c, width):
+    """1 x 32 block ``tid + 512 i`` of the S ``hidden`` rows (bf16, ``width``
+    wide): its 64 B."""
+    s, tid, a = c["S"], c["tid"], c["args"]
+    nblk = width // 32
+    nb = s * nblk
+    out = []
+    for i in range((nb + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        b = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, nb - 1)
+        at = (b // nblk * width + 32 * (b % nblk)) // 2
+        out.append([ld4(rsrc(a["hidden"]), at + 4 * k) for k in range(4)])
+    return out
+
+
+@traced
+def block_quant(c, raw, width, dq, ds, qrow, srow):
+    """``block_loads``' blocks through MXFP4 qdq (a thread a 1 x 32 block) ->
+    LDS rows (fp4 at ``dq`` + ``qrow`` i32 a row, codes at ``ds`` + ``srow``)."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    nblk = width // 32
+    nb = s * nblk
+    for i in range_constexpr(len(raw)):
+        b = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, nb - 1)
+        t = b // nblk
+        blk = b % nblk
+        vs = []
+        for k in range_constexpr(4):
+            for d in range_constexpr(4):
+                vs += [bf_lo(raw[i][k][d]), bf_hi(raw[i][k][d])]
+        amax = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for e in range_constexpr(32):
+            amax = fx.max(amax, fx.Float32(fmath.absf(vs[e])))
+        code = mx_code(amax)
+        qs = [pack8(vs[8 * k : 8 * k + 8], code) for k in range(4)]
+        if tid + THREADS * i < nb:
+            fx.ptr_store(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(qs, fx.Int32), dq + (t * qrow + 4 * blk)
+            )
+            fx.ptr_store(code, ds + (t * srow + blk))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def core_loads(c):
+    return block_loads(c, CORE)
+
+
+def o_lane(c):
+    """The norm thread (token t, run j of 8 of the owner's 32 columns)."""
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    return fx.min(tid // 4, c["S"] - 1), tid % 4
+
+
+def o_res_loads(c, own=None):
+    """The norm thread's residual and 1 + w words (8 columns of owner ``own``)."""
+    a = c["args"]
+    t, j = o_lane(c)
+    col = 2 * ROWS * o_owner(c, own) + 8 * j
+    return ld4(rsrc(a["residual"]), (t * HIDDEN + col) // 2), ld4(
+        rsrc(a["ln_w"]), col // 2
+    )
+
+
+def o_loads(c, width=CORE, splits=4, own=None):
+    """Wave w: owner ``own``'s (the CTA's first by default) row group w % 2, K
+    split w / 2 of ``splits`` (of o_proj's K, ``width``: the stock GEMM's split-K
+    partition); past the weight (no traffic) for an owner past the last, or a
+    wave past the splits."""
+    lane, wave, a = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["args"]
+    bid = owner(c, own)
+    o_q = width // STEP // splits
+    row = (2 * bid + wave % 2) * ROWS + lane % ROWS
+    live = bid < O_CTAS
+    if const_expr(2 * splits < WAVES):
+        live = live & (wave < 2 * splits)
+    row = live.select(row, fx.Int32(HIDDEN))
+    r_w = rsrc(a["w_o"], HIDDEN * width // 2)
+    r_s = rsrc(a["w_os"], HIDDEN * width // 32)
+    steps = [wave // 2 * o_q + i for i in range(o_q)]
+    tiles = [
+        ld4(r_w, row // ROWS * (ROWS * width // 8) + st * 256 + lane * 4, CM_NT)
+        for st in steps
+    ]
+    words = [
+        fx.Int32(
+            bo.buffer_load(r_s, row * (width // 128) + st, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32)
+        )
+        for st in steps
+    ]
+    return tiles, words
+
+
+def o_quant(c, craw):
+    """The core rows through MXFP4 qdq -> LDS."""
+    block_quant(c, craw, CORE, c["oq"], c["os"], OQROW, OSROW)
+
+
+def x_quant(c, xraw):
+    """``normed``: the x rows (the stock norm's output) through MXFP4 qdq ->
+    the LDS x rows."""
+    block_quant(c, xraw, HIDDEN, c["xq"], c["xs"], XQROW, XSROW)
+
+
+@traced
+def o_stage(c, ops, width=CORE, splits=4):
+    """The wave's K split of the owner's row group, its steps chained in order
+    -> red (the core rows' qdq in LDS, ``width // 8 + 4`` i32 a row)."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    o_q = width // STEP // splits
+    gl = lane // ROWS
+    t = fx.min(lane % ROWS, c["S"] - 1)
+    tiles, words = ops
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    for i in range_constexpr(o_q):
+        st = wave // 2 * o_q + i
+        acc = scaled_step(
+            c["oq"],
+            c["os"],
+            t * (width // 8 + 4),
+            t * (width // 32),
+            fx.min(st, width // STEP - 1),
+            gl,
+            tiles[i],
+            words[i],
+            acc,
+        )
+    fx.ptr_store(acc, c["red"] + (wave * 64 + lane) * 4)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def o_finish(c, rraw, own=None):
+    """Norm thread (t, j) of owner ``own`` (the CTA's first by default): the
+    o_proj rows' K splits added as stock's reduce -> bf16 (the stock GEMM's
+    output) + residual = z -> res_out; the chunk's sum of squares -> NSUM.
+    Returns z, 1 + w."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    bid = owner(c, own)
+    t, j = o_lane(c)
+    rw, wv = rraw
+    res, lnw = [], []
+    for d in range_constexpr(4):
+        res += [bf_lo(rw[d]), bf_hi(rw[d])]
+        lnw += [fx.Float32(1.0) + bf_lo(wv[d]), fx.Float32(1.0) + bf_hi(wv[d])]
+    z = [
+        bf16_round(
+            split_total(
+                red_at(c["red"], 2 * k + j // 2, 8 * (j % 2) + e, t)
+                for k in range(c["o_n"])
+            )
+        )
+        + res[e]
+        for e in range(8)
+    ]
+    live = (tid < s * 4) & (bid < O_CTAS)
+    if live:
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(pack_bf(z), fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(c["args"]["res_out"]),
+            (t * HIDDEN + 2 * ROWS * bid + 8 * j) // 2,
+        )
+        c["put"](c["nsum"], t * CHUNKS + 4 * bid + j, chunk_ss(z))
+    return z, lnw
+
+
+def o_more_loads(c):
+    """(owner, residual words, o weights) of each of the CTA's owner tasks past
+    its first (``o_more``; none on 256 CTAs)."""
+    return [
+        (own, o_res_loads(c, own), o_loads(c, splits=c["o_n"], own=own))
+        for own in o_more(c)
+    ]
+
+
+def o_more_passes(c, more, width=CORE, splits=4):
+    """``o_stage`` and ``o_finish`` of each owner of ``more`` (``o_more_loads``),
+    a barrier first: the previous ``o_finish`` reads RED, which the next chains
+    overwrite. Returns (z, 1 + w, owner) each."""
+    out = []
+    for own, rraw, ops in more:
+        gpu.barrier()
+        o_stage(c, ops, width, splits)
+        z, lnw = o_finish(c, rraw, own)
+        out.append((z, lnw, own))
+    return out
+
+
+def o_more_x(c, zs):
+    """``o_x`` of each owner of ``zs`` (``o_more_passes``)."""
+    for z, lnw, own in zs:
+        o_x(c, z, lnw, own)

+@traced
+def o_rstd(c):
+    """Owner CTAs: wave t reduces token t's chunk sums as the stock norm (lane l:
+    chunk l of each run of 64) -> rstd -> LDS."""
+    s, tid, lane, bid = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["bid"]
+    if (tid < s * 64) & (bid < O_CTAS):
+        t = tid // 64
+        got = c["poll"](
+            [(c["nsum"], t * CHUNKS + 64 * k + lane, 1) for k in range(CH_WAVES)]
+        )
+        runs = [butterfly(g[0].bitcast(fx.Float32), WAVE_ORDER) for g in got]
+        if lane == 0:
+            fx.ptr_store(stock_rstd(runs_total(runs), c["eps"]), c["rst"] + t)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def o_x(c, z, lnw, own=None):
+    """Norm thread (t, j) of owner ``own`` (the CTA's first by default): bf16 x
+    -> the 1 x 32 block's code (over the 4 threads) -> its fp4 word (and the
+    code) put for every CTA."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    bid = owner(c, own)
+    t, j = o_lane(c)
+    r = fx.ptr_load(c["rst"] + t)
+    x = [bf16_round(z[e] * r * lnw[e]) for e in range(8)]
+    amax = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for e in range_constexpr(8):
+        amax = fx.max(amax, fx.Float32(fmath.absf(x[e])))
+    amax = xred(xred(amax, 1, fx.max), 2, fx.max)
+    code = mx_code(amax)
+    w = pack8(x, code)
+    if (tid < s * 4) & (bid < O_CTAS):
+        base = (t * O_CTAS + bid) * X_PAIRS
+        c["put_words"](c["xmb"], base + j, [w])
+        if j == 0:
+            c["put_words"](c["xmb"], base + 4, [code])
+
+
+@traced
+def o_gather(c):
+    """Every owner's fp4 x words and codes -> the LDS x rows."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    n = s * O_CTAS
+    rounds = (n + THREADS - 1) // THREADS
+    units = [fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, n - 1) for i in range(rounds)]
+    specs = []
+    for u in units:
+        base = u * X_PAIRS
+        specs += [(c["xmb"], base, 2), (c["xmb"], base + 2, 2), (c["xmb"], base + 4, 1)]
+    got = c["poll"](specs)
+    for i in range_constexpr(rounds):
+        u = units[i]
+        t = u // O_CTAS
+        b = u % O_CTAS
+        ws = [got[3 * i][0], got[3 * i][1], got[3 * i + 1][0], got[3 * i + 1][1]]
+        if tid + THREADS * i < n:
+            fx.ptr_store(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(ws, fx.Int32), c["xq"] + (t * XQROW + 4 * b)
+            )
+            fx.ptr_store(got[3 * i + 2][0], c["xs"] + (t * XSROW + b))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- chains
+def red_at(red, w, r, t):
+    """Row r, token t of wave w's 16x16 MFMA accumulator (at ``red`` + (w * 64 +
+    lane) * 4)."""
+    return fx.ptr_load(red + ((w * 64 + 16 * (r // 4) + t) * 4 + r % 4))
+
+
+@traced
+def chained(c, buf, q, per, run):
+    """The tiles' K chains, a quarter a wave (wave 2 q + its tile, quarter q
+    traced): quarter q is position q % ``per`` of its split's chain. Phase p:
+    the waves at position p continue the accumulator of wave - 2 (zero at a
+    split's start) in ``buf`` (wave w's at (w * 64 + lane) * 4) by ``run`` and
+    store theirs there."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    vec4 = fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Float32)
+    for p in range_constexpr(per):
+        if q % per == p:
+            if const_expr(p == 0):
+                acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+            else:
+                acc = fx.Vector(
+                    fx.ptr_load(buf + ((wave - 2) * 64 + lane) * 4, result_type=vec4)
+                )
+            fx.ptr_store(run(acc), buf + (wave * 64 + lane) * 4)
+        gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def split_ends(n, per):
+    """The quarters ending the ``n`` splits (``per`` quarters each)."""
+    return [per * k + per - 1 for k in range(n)]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gate_up
+def w13_loads(c, row, steps):
+    """This lane's w13 tiles of ``row`` at K steps ``steps`` (traced, each) and
+    their scale words (byte lane / 16 of each)."""
+    lane, a, geo = c["lane"], c["args"], c["G"]
+    gl = lane // ROWS
+    r_w = rsrc(a["w13"], 2 * geo.inter * HIDDEN // 2)
+    r_s = rsrc(a["w13s"], 2 * geo.inter * HIDDEN // 32)
+    if c["shuffled"]:
+        at = [row // ROWS * (ROWS * W13_DW) + st * 256 + lane * 4 for st in steps]
+    else:
+        at = [row * W13_DW + st * 16 + 4 * gl for st in steps]
+    tiles = [ld4(r_w, a_, CM_NT) for a_ in at]
+    words = [
+        fx.Int32(bo.buffer_load(r_s, row * W13S_DW + st, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32))
+        for st in steps
+    ]
+    return tiles, words
+
+
+def gu_row(c, g, sliver):
+    """This lane's w13 row of group g, gate / up by wave % 2; of the split group
+    (``sliver``) only the CTA's ``sl_cols`` columns, the others dead."""
+    lane, wave, geo = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["G"]
+    row = ((wave % 2) * geo.ng + g) * ROWS + lane % ROWS
+    if const_expr(sliver):
+        off = sl_off(c)
+        live = (lane % ROWS >= off) & (lane % ROWS < off + geo.sl_cols)
+        row = live.select(row, fx.Int32(2 * geo.inter))
+    return row
+
+
+def sl_off(c):
+    """The first of the CTA's columns in its split group."""
+    geo = c["G"]
+    return c["bid"] % (ROWS // geo.sl_cols) * geo.sl_cols
+
+
+def sl_group(c):
+    geo = c["G"]
+    return geo.g_full * geo.grid + c["bid"] // (ROWS // geo.sl_cols)
+
+
+def gu_loads(c, g, sliver=False):
+    """Group g: wave w's gate / up rows (w % 2), its K quarter w / 2."""
+    kq = c["wave"] // 2
+    return w13_loads(c, gu_row(c, g, sliver), [kq * GU_Q + i for i in range(GU_Q)])
+
+
+def gu_mfmas(c, tiles, words, steps, acc=None):
+    """The steps chained in order onto ``acc`` (None: a chain from zero)."""
+    if acc is None:
+        acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    lane = c["lane"]
+    gl = lane // ROWS
+    t = fx.min(lane % ROWS, c["S"] - 1)
+    for i in range_constexpr(len(tiles)):
+        acc = scaled_step(
+            c["xq"],
+            c["xs"],
+            t * XQROW,
+            t * XSROW,
+            steps[i],
+            gl,
+            tiles[i],
+            words[i],
+            acc,
+        )
+    return acc
+
+
+def scaled_step(aq, as_, qrow, srow, st, gl, tile, word, acc):
+    """One 128-K step: the lane's 32 fp4 of its weight row (byte gl of ``word``
+    its e8m0) against the 32 fp4 of its token's activation row in LDS (``aq`` +
+    ``qrow`` i32, its code at ``as_`` + ``srow``), one scaled MFMA."""
+    bw = fx.Vector(
+        fx.ptr_load(
+            aq + (qrow + st * 16 + gl * 4), result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32)
+        )
+    )
+    sb = fx.ptr_load(as_ + (srow + st * 4 + gl))
+    sa = (word >> (gl * 8)) & 0xFF
+    return mfma_scaled(tile, bw, acc, sa, sb, FP4, FP4, 0, 0)
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_gu(c, j, g, ops, sliver):
+    """Group g, the CTA's j-th: the K chains (``chained``) -> red; thread (token,
+    column pair): gate and up, the splits added as stock's reduce, bf16 each ->
+    h (``h_out``)."""
+    s, tid, wave, red = c["S"], c["tid"], c["wave"], c["red"]
+    n = c["gu_n"]
+    per = QUARTERS // n
+    kq = wave // 2
+    steps = [kq * GU_Q + i for i in range(GU_Q)]
+    chained(c, red, kq, per, lambda acc: gu_mfmas(c, ops[0], ops[1], steps, acc))
+    if tid < s * (ROWS // 2):
+        tt = tid // (ROWS // 2)
+        cp = tid % (ROWS // 2)
+        ends = split_ends(n, per)
+        gv = [
+            bf16_round(split_total(red_at(red, 2 * q, 2 * cp + d, tt) for q in ends))
+            for d in range(2)
+        ]
+        uv = [
+            bf16_round(
+                split_total(red_at(red, 2 * q + 1, 2 * cp + d, tt) for q in ends)
+            )
+            for d in range(2)
+        ]
+        h_out(c, j, g, tt, cp, gv, uv, sliver)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def h_out(c, j, g, tt, cp, gv, uv, sliver):
+    """bf16 h of columns 16 g + 2 cp + (0, 1), token tt: a whole group's -> the
+    LDS pair (HP, its half j % 2); the split group's live columns -> H."""
+    v = [silu_mul_bf(gv[d], uv[d]) for d in range(2)]
+    if const_expr(sliver):
+        off = sl_off(c)
+        if (2 * cp >= off) & (2 * cp < off + c["G"].sl_cols):
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                pack_bf(v)[0],
+                rsrc(c["hbuf"]),
+                (tt * c["G"].inter + g * ROWS + 2 * cp) // 2,
+                cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+            )
+    else:
+        for d in range_constexpr(2):
+            fx.ptr_store(
+                bf16_round(v[d]), c["hp"] + (tt * 32 + (j % 2) * ROWS + 2 * cp + d)
+            )
+
+
+@traced
+def h_quant(c, g):
+    """Thread t < S: the h of whole groups g - 1, g (one 1 x 32 block, in HP)
+    through MXFP4 qdq -> its fp4 words and code -> HQ."""
+    s, tid, geo = c["S"], c["tid"], c["G"]
+    if tid < s:
+        vs = [fx.ptr_load(c["hp"] + (tid * 32 + e)) for e in range(32)]
+        amax = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for e in range_constexpr(32):
+            amax = fx.max(amax, fx.Float32(fmath.absf(vs[e])))
+        code = mx_code(amax)
+        qs = [pack8(vs[8 * k : 8 * k + 8], code) for k in range(4)]
+        blk = (g - 1) * ROWS // 32
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(qs, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(c["hq4"]),
+            (tid * geo.blocks + blk) * 4,
+            cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+        )
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            code, rsrc(c["hq4s"]), tid * geo.blocks + blk, cache_modifier=CM_DEV
+        )
+
+
+@traced
+def run_gate_up(c, ops):
+    """The whole groups (a group's weights in flight under the previous one,
+    ``ops`` the first's since the start) and each pair's qdq, then the split
+    group's columns; one flag."""
+    bid, tid, geo = c["bid"], c["tid"], c["G"]
+    g0 = geo.g_full * bid
+    for j in range_constexpr(geo.g_full + 1):
+        sliver = j == geo.g_full
+        if const_expr(j + 1 < geo.g_full):
+            ops_n = gu_loads(c, g0 + j + 1)
+        elif const_expr(j + 1 == geo.g_full):
+            ops_n = gu_loads(c, sl_group(c), sliver=True)
+        stage_gu(c, j, sl_group(c) if sliver else g0 + j, ops, sliver)
+        if const_expr(j % 2 == 1 and not sliver):
+            h_quant(c, g0 + j)
+        if const_expr(not sliver):
+            ops = ops_n
+    publish(c["put"], c["hrdy"], bid, fx.Int32(1), tid == 0)
+
+
+def row_sum_waves(red, r, t, gu, n=4):
+    """Row r, token t summed over the waves of gate (gu 0: 0, 2, 4, 6) or up
+    (1, 3, 5, 7), the first ``n`` of them, in order (gu traced)."""
+    tot = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for k in range(n):
+        w = 2 * k + gu
+        tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red + ((w * 64 + 16 * (r // 4) + t) * 4 + r % 4))
+    return tot
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- down
+def d_tile_row(c, i):
+    """This lane's w2 row of the CTA's tile ``i`` (``FGeo.d_pass_tiles``): of
+    whole row group i grid + b, of the CTA's ``d_sl_rows`` rows of split group
+    d_full + b / (16 / d_sl_rows) (the group's other rows dead), or (None) past
+    the weight."""
+    lane, bid, geo = c["lane"], c["bid"], c["G"]
+    if i is None:
+        return fx.Int32(HIDDEN)
+    if i < geo.d_per:
+        return plus(bid, i * geo.grid) * ROWS + lane % ROWS
+    off = d_off(c)
+    live = (lane % ROWS >= off) & (lane % ROWS < off + geo.d_sl_rows)
+    return live.select(
+        (geo.d_full + bid // (ROWS // geo.d_sl_rows)) * ROWS + lane % ROWS,
+        fx.Int32(HIDDEN),
+    )
+
+
+def d_row(c, p=0):
+    """This lane's w2 row: pass ``p``'s tile on the wave's parity. On 256 CTAs
+    the one pass is whole row group b on the even waves, 4 rows of split group
+    256 + b / 4 on the odd; on 128, groups b and 128 + b, then 8 rows of split
+    group 256 + b / 2 on the even waves (the odd ones dead)."""
+    even, odd = c["G"].d_pass_tiles(p)
+    odd_row = d_tile_row(c, odd)
+    return (c["wave"] % 2 == 0).select(d_tile_row(c, even), odd_row)
+
+
+def d_off(c):
+    """The first of the CTA's rows in its split row group."""
+    geo = c["G"]
+    return c["bid"] % (ROWS // geo.d_sl_rows) * geo.d_sl_rows
+
+
+def d_out_base(c, i):
+    """The first hidden row of the CTA's tile ``i`` (0 for none)."""
+    bid, geo = c["bid"], c["G"]
+    if i is None:
+        return fx.Int32(0)
+    if i < geo.d_per:
+        return plus(bid, i * geo.grid) * ROWS
+    return (geo.d_full + bid // (ROWS // geo.d_sl_rows)) * ROWS
+
+
+def d_out_live(c, tile, rp, tiles):
+    """Whether output thread (``tile`` parity, row pair ``rp``) writes: every row
+    pair of a whole group, the CTA's of the split group, none of no tile."""
+    geo = c["G"]
+    out = None
+    for parity, i in enumerate(tiles):
+        if i is None:
+            continue
+        on = tile == parity
+        if i == geo.d_per:
+            off = d_off(c)
+            on = on & ((2 * rp >= off) & (2 * rp < off + geo.d_sl_rows))
+        out = on if out is None else out | on
+    return out
+
+
+def down_loads(c, p=0):
+    """The wave's K quarter (wave / 2) of its row in pass ``p``: tiles and
+    scale words."""
+    lane, wave, geo, a = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["G"], c["args"]
+    gl = lane // ROWS
+    r_w = rsrc(a["w2"], HIDDEN * geo.inter // 2)
+    r_s = rsrc(a["w2s"], HIDDEN * geo.inter // 32)
+    row = d_row(c, p)
+    kq = wave // 2
+    tiles, words = [], []
+    for i in range(geo.d_q):
+        st = kq * geo.d_q + i
+        if c["shuffled"]:
+            at = row // ROWS * (ROWS * geo.w2_dw) + st * 256 + lane * 4
+        else:
+            at = row * geo.w2_dw + st * 16 + 4 * gl
+        tiles.append(ld4(r_w, at, CM_NT))
+        words.append(
+            fx.Int32(
+                bo.buffer_load(r_s, row * geo.w2s_dw + st, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32)
+            )
+        )
+    return tiles, words
+
+
+@traced
+def load_h(c):
+    """Every CTA's H ready -> HQ's blocks, and the split groups' columns of H
+    through MXFP4 qdq (a thread a 1 x 32 block), -> LDS rows of hqrow / hsrow."""
+    s, tid, geo = c["S"], c["tid"], c["G"]
+    if tid < geo.grid:
+        c["poll"]([(c["hrdy"], tid, 1)])
+    gpu.barrier()
+    nb = s * geo.bulk_blocks
+    for i in range_constexpr((nb + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        b = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, nb - 1)
+        t = b // geo.bulk_blocks
+        blk = b % geo.bulk_blocks
+        w = ld4(rsrc(c["hq4"]), (t * geo.blocks + blk) * 4, CM_DEV)
+        code = fx.Int32(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(c["hq4s"]),
+                t * geo.blocks + blk,
+                vec_width=1,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+                cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+            )
+        )
+        if tid + THREADS * i < nb:
+            fx.ptr_store(w, c["hq"] + (t * geo.hqrow + 4 * blk))
+            fx.ptr_store(code, c["hs"] + (t * geo.hsrow + blk))
+    sl_blocks = geo.blocks - geo.bulk_blocks
+    ns = s * sl_blocks
+    r_h = rsrc(c["hbuf"])
+    for i in range_constexpr((ns + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        b = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, ns - 1)
+        t = b // sl_blocks
+        blk = geo.bulk_blocks + b % sl_blocks
+        at = (t * geo.inter + 32 * blk) // 2
+        ws = [ld4(r_h, at + 4 * k, CM_DEV) for k in range(4)]
+        vs = []
+        for k in range_constexpr(4):
+            for d in range_constexpr(4):
+                vs += [bf_lo(ws[k][d]), bf_hi(ws[k][d])]
+        amax = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for e in range_constexpr(32):
+            amax = fx.max(amax, fx.Float32(fmath.absf(vs[e])))
+        code = mx_code(amax)
+        qs = [pack8(vs[8 * k : 8 * k + 8], code) for k in range(4)]
+        if tid + THREADS * i < ns:
+            fx.ptr_store(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(qs, fx.Int32),
+                c["hq"] + (t * geo.hqrow + 4 * blk),
+            )
+            fx.ptr_store(code, c["hs"] + (t * geo.hsrow + blk))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_down(c, ops, p=0, nxt=None):
+    """Pass ``p``: the K chains (``chained``) -> DRED, then ``nxt()`` (the next
+    pass's loads, returned); thread (tile, token, row pair): the splits added as
+    stock's reduce -> bf16 ``out`` (of the split row group, the CTA's rows
+    only)."""
+    s, lane, wave, geo = c["S"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["G"]
+    dred = c["dred"]
+    tiles, words = ops
+    gl = lane // ROWS
+    t = fx.min(lane % ROWS, s - 1)
+    kq = wave // 2
+    n = c["d_n"]
+    per = QUARTERS // n
+
+    def run(acc):
+        for i in range_constexpr(geo.d_q):
+            acc = scaled_step(
+                c["hq"],
+                c["hs"],
+                t * geo.hqrow,
+                t * geo.hsrow,
+                kq * geo.d_q + i,
+                gl,
+                tiles[i],
+                words[i],
+                acc,
+            )
+        return acc
+
+    chained(c, dred, kq, per, run)
+    ops_n = None
+    if const_expr(nxt is not None):
+        ops_n = nxt()
+    tiles_p = geo.d_pass_tiles(p)
+    if const_expr(tiles_p == (0, geo.d_per)):
+        down_out_split(c, n, per)
+    else:
+        down_out(c, n, per, tiles_p)
+    return ops_n
+
+
+@traced
+def down_out_split(c, n, per):
+    """The pass of whole row group b (even waves) and the split group's rows
+    (odd): thread (tile, token, row pair) -> ``out`` (256 CTAs)."""
+    s, tid, geo, bid, dred = c["S"], c["tid"], c["G"], c["bid"], c["dred"]
+    if tid < 2 * s * (ROWS // 2):
+        tile = tid // (s * (ROWS // 2))
+        tt = tid % (s * (ROWS // 2)) // (ROWS // 2)
+        rp = tid % (ROWS // 2)
+        y = [

+decode step from the layer's input (the previous layer's FFN output + residual;
+at TP2 after its all-reduce) to the gated core (out_proj's input, ``dense_ffn``'s
+with ``oproj``), S <= 8 rows, one token a request. At TP2 a rank runs its half
+of the heads (``Geo``) on the full input; nothing crosses ranks. One launch,
+``grid`` x ``THREADS`` (sizes at TP1, TP2 in brackets):
+
+    front    (CTAs 0 .. 159, 32 hidden columns each): h + residual -> ``res_out``;
+             sum-of-squares partials -> rstd -> input_layernorm (Gemma, 1 + w)
+             -> bf16 x -> MXFP4 blocks put for every CTA -> the LDS x rows
+             (``dense_ffn``'s distributed norm). With ``normed`` (the stock
+             input norm ran) every CTA quantizes the normed rows itself
+    in_proj  in_proj_qkvz: 1024 [512] groups of 16 rows, CTA b groups 4 b ..
+             [2 b ..]; wave w group w / 2, K half w % 2 -> bf16 PROJ entries.
+             in_proj_ba: 6 [3] groups x 8 K eighths on CTAs 0 .. 47 [23] -> fp32
+             partials (BAP)
+    gdn      tasks of 8 state rows (48 [24] value heads x 16 chunks a token:
+             3 S [ceil(1.5 S)] a CTA), phase by phase over the CTA's tasks so
+             each hand-off is waited on once:
+               conv   the task's 8 v channels; the key head's first value head
+                      also its 8 q and 8 k channels (out through QK). Window
+                      updated in place, products rounded to bf16, SiLU -> bf16
+               gates  q / k of the key head (QK) l2-normed, q * HD^-1/2; b, a
+                      (the BAP partials in order, bf16) -> beta, decay
+               recur  the delta rule on the 8 rows (fp32 state in place) ->
+                      bf16 o -> OV
+               norm   RMSNormGated over the head (all 128 o from OV) * silu(z)
+                      -> the task's 8 core rows
+    out_proj (``oproj``, TP2 from ``normed``): every CTA's core rows ready (one
+             flag a CTA) -> CTAs 0 .. 159 qdq the S core rows and run their 32
+             hidden columns of out_proj's K share (``dense_ffn``'s o_proj stage)
+             in the stock GEMM's K splits (``o_splits``), each chained in order,
+             the splits summed in order -> bf16 ``out``, the rank's partial
+
+The CTA counts above are the 256-CTA grid (``K1Build.grid``, MI355X). On 128
+CTAs (MI350P, ``tiling``) a CTA takes 8 [4] qkvz groups, at TP1 in two passes
+of 4; 6 S [3 S] GDN tasks, in one pass at TP1 and in passes of whole tokens
+above 24 tasks at TP2 (``tiling.gdn_passes``: S > 8); and front's / out_proj's
+owners 128 + b (b < 32) in a second pass. Up to ``LOCAL_NORM_ROWS`` rows the
+front has no owners: every CTA runs the input norm on the whole rows itself
+(``dense_ffn.run_norm``, the owners' reduction order) and writes x to its own
+LDS. Each task's arithmetic is the same at either width.
+
+Bit-exact with the stock decode path (the Triton conv update,
+``fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode``, RMSNormGated): the same
+rounding, lane layouts, reduction orders, FMA contractions and transcendental
+lowerings as their gfx950 code. Two of these depend on the stock code's
+version and launch: beta = sigmoid(b) stays fp32 (as the stock kernel since

+2 x CUs, so 6 rows and up at TP1 on 128 CUs). A row whose state slot is -1

+    first: bool = False  # the model's first layer: no residual (residual := hidden)
+    eps: float = 1e-6  # input_layernorm
+    norm_eps: float = 1e-6  # the gated norm
+    tp: int = 1  # this rank's heads (``Geo``)
+    # hidden is input_layernorm's output (the stock norm ran): no add, no norm
+    normed: bool = False
+    # out_proj folded in (``normed`` only): ``out`` gets its bf16 [S, HIDDEN]
+    # output (the rank's partial at TP2), ``w_o`` / ``w_os`` its shuffled weights
+    oproj: bool = False
+    stamps: bool = False  # debug: per-CTA s_memrealtime stamps -> scratch "stamps"
+    stop: int = 99  # debug: phases < stop (1 front, 2 in_proj, 3 gdn, 4 out_proj)
+    # CTAs, one a CU, all resident (``tiling.resolve_grid``): 256 MI355X, 128
+    # MI350P
+    grid: int = DEFAULT_GRID
+    # the stock gated norm's rows a program (``stock_fields``): 1 or 2
+    norm_rows: int = 1
+    # out_proj's K splits (``oproj``; ``stock_fields``), 0 for ``o_splits``
+    o_split: int = 0
+    # speculative decoding (TP1): a request's tokens in a verify step (1 + the
+    # draft tokens); its rows are ``tokens / spec`` requests of ``spec`` tokens.
+    # 0: one token a request.
+    spec: int = 0
+    # ``spec``: the numerics of the fused MTP decode kernel
+    # (``fused_gdn_decode_post_conv_mtp``) in place of
+    # ``fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update`` + RMSNormGated
+    spec_fused: bool = False
+
+
+ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "hidden",
+        "residual",
+        "res_out",
+        "ln_w",
+        "w_qkvz",
+        "w_qkvzs",
+        "w_ba",
+        "w_bas",
+        "conv_w",
+        "conv_st",
+        "cs_seq",
+        "cs_dim",
+        "cs_tok",
+        "a_log",
+        "dt_bias",
+        "norm_w",
+        "rstate",
+        "rs_seq",
+        "st_idx",
+        "core",
+        "w_o",
+        "w_os",
+        "out",
+        "scratch",
+        "epoch",
+        "layer",
+    )
+)
